glosses: transit (the act of passing through or over something)
transit (the passage of a celestial body across the observer’s meridian or across the disk of a larger celestial body)

examples.text: Provavelmente houve um acidente de trânsito.
examples.en: There's probably been a traffic accident.
Did you get stuck in traffic?

examples.text: O trânsito é pesado por aqui.
Tom morreu num acidente de trânsito.
examples.en: Tom died in a traffic accident.
